name: weather
prompt:
Explain what this Renyi program does in at most three sentences, for a reader who will decide whether to use it. Do not quote code.

module weather
  purpose: Show the current temperature for Berlin using the Open-Meteo API.

import std.console
import std.http exposing Url, HttpError
import std.json exposing JsonError

type CurrentWeather
  has temperature_2m: Decimal
  has wind_speed_10m: Decimal
  can FromJson
end

type Forecast
  has current: CurrentWeather
  can FromJson
end

public type WeatherError is one of
  purpose: Why a forecast could not be shown.
  Unreachable(detail: Text)
  BadResponse(detail: Text)
end

public function fetch_forecast(latitude: Decimal, longitude: Decimal)
  returns Forecast
  or fails with HttpError or JsonError
  needs network.http("api.open-meteo.com")
  purpose: Download the current weather for one coordinate.
  tags: weather, http, json

  let base be "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"
  let query be "latitude={latitude}&longitude={longitude}&current=temperature_2m,wind_speed_10m"
  let url be Url("{base}?{query}")
  let response be http.get(url) otherwise fail
  let forecast: Forecast be json.parse(response.body) otherwise fail
  return forecast
end

public function main() or fails with WeatherError needs console, network.http
  purpose: Print the temperature and wind speed in Berlin.

  let forecast be
    match fetch_forecast(latitude: 52.52, longitude: 13.41)
      when success(result) then result
      when failure(error: HttpError) then fail with Unreachable(detail: error.to_text())
      when failure(error: JsonError) then fail with BadResponse(detail: error.to_text())
    end
  let current be forecast.current
  console.print("Berlin: {current.temperature_2m} C, wind {current.wind_speed_10m} km/h")
end

test "Berlin is read" needs network.http("api.open-meteo.com") replays "fixtures/weather.json"
  let forecast be fetch_forecast(latitude: 52.52, longitude: 13.41) otherwise fail
  check forecast.current.temperature_2m is 14.0
  check forecast.current.wind_speed_10m is 5.5
end
